build: python scripts/generate_pages.py && python scripts/generate_category_pages.py && python scripts/generate_company_pages.py && python scripts/generate_salary_page.py && python scripts/generate_homepage.py && python scripts/generate_sitemap.py
deploy: Cloudflare Pages serves site/. Deployed only by .github/workflows/update-jobs.yml (daily 06:00 UTC, or workflow_dispatch), which runs filter_jobs.py and scrape_details.py first, then the build above, commits site/ and runs wrangler pages deploy. Pushing to main does not deploy.

jobs.source: site/jobs.json (written by scripts/filter_jobs.py + scripts/scrape_details.py; never hand-edit)
jobs.notes: slug = {company}-{title}-{md5(url)[:6]}; never change slug logic. Expired jobs get noindex and are left out of the sitemap.

categories.source: scripts/generate_category_pages.py CATEGORIES list (slug, name, h1, meta_description, intro, keyword rules); copy an existing entry to add one
categories.template: CATEGORY_TEMPLATE + INDEX_TEMPLATE in the same file

companies.source: generated from jobs.json; display names in scripts/filter_jobs.py company mapping

pages.source: hand-written site/index.html (job list and JSON-LD injected between markers by scripts/generate_homepage.py), site/about.html, site/post-a-job.html
pages.format: plain HTML; copy site/about.html as the model for a new static page, then add it to scripts/generate_sitemap.py static list

templateRules: Fix SEO issues in the generator templates in scripts/, never in generated files under site/jobs, site/category, site/companies, site/salary.html, site/categories.html.
Keep all templates consistent: generate_pages.py, generate_category_pages.py (2), generate_company_pages.py (2), generate_salary_page.py, plus hand-written index.html, about.html, post-a-job.html.
Every template keeps the gtag script (/analytics.js, G-C0EB4GHJS3) immediately after <head>.
After changing a template, re-run the build and commit the regenerated site/ files.

brand.voice: plain, direct, job-seeker first; no hype
brand.cta: Apply on the employer's career page (outbound Apply button); secondary: /post-a-job for employers
never: A URL ending in .html in any canonical tag, og:url, sitemap entry or JSON-LD URL; these must be extensionless (https://remotepharmacistjobs.com/jobs/<slug>, not .../<slug>.html). Internal <a href> links may keep .html.
Changing the job slug logic or any existing page URL
